comments.text:
I **really** want to like MMOs, (flat or VR) but almost ever single MMO I’ve tried for the past the twenty years has been a generic remake of the same formulaic game model, again, and again, and again.

I’m not trying to be “that guy” (hater) about this, and I’ll probably give it a try, so I really hope the Devs surprise me, but at this point, MMOs have done a lot to lose my trust… correction… MMOs **haven’t** done a lot to earn my trust

That said, I will hold off on my judgment… for now
